reviews.comment: She was the absolute sweetest professor I've ever had. The class is so easy, it's jus memorization of pwpts. She only grades on the stuff she taught. So sweet & genuinely cared for her students. She gave extensions if they were absolutly necessary. She really listened to her students and I feel like she was the best prof I've had at Mays.

Professor Mahajan is one of the kindest professors I've had at TAMU. She encourages breaks during class, and promotes understanding of the material (literally refuses to move on unless she is verbally made aware that the class understands) I took this as an 8am, so most of the time I wasn't really awake.. but if you take good notes you'll be fine.

Professor Mahajan is such a caring professor who truly wants to see her students succeed. She is very passionate about what she teaches. Her lectures can be quite saturating, but she gives mental breaks in class which I think is very nice. Overall, her tests and assignments were pretty straightforward. Material is interesting. Easy A or B

Professor Mahajan is the BEST!! She's so nice, willing to answer questions, and really cares about her students. There are 3 exams that are non-cumulative, 4 quizzes, some homework assignments, and a group project that is super fun and easy. Overall, it's a doable class and she's such a great professor. Take her class!
She loves her students too much to see them waste their potential. Amazing global perspective as well.

I LOVED having Professor Mahajan. I don't know if I have ever had a prof that genuinely cares this much about her students. She checks every week to make sure everyone is okay with how the class is being taught and asks for advice on how to do better. I loved learning this material from her and wish I could take her again! Take her if you can!

Love. Love. LOVE. Professor Mahajan genuinely cares so much about her students. I have taken two courses with her, and I wish I could take another. She works hard to make sure all students understand the material and knows why what theyre learning is important. Shes the best.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: BEST prof for busi majors. She's super sweet and really cares about her students. She wants her students not just to memorize the material but actually understand concepts and reasonings and explains things so easily. I studied for exams and quizzes the day before and made an A. Do read the txtbook. It's not too long or boring to understand.

She's so kind and genuinely cares about her students. Quizzes every Tuesday which gets tiring, but they're not too hard. Don't have to read textbook if you pay attention in class and go through her slides to study. A few extra articles will be on test but overall not bad.

One of the sweetest and most caring professors I've had. She genuinely cares about whether or not you're learning this stuff and is super accessible. 3 tests/3 small assignments/1 group presentation. As long as you read the book, take good notes in class (she'll emphasize what's important), and study 3-4 days before you should be getting an A

She is a very nice prof and truly enjoys helping students. The class has 3 exams, 3 assignments that are easy (she checks them for you if you ask), a 1 time group project, and super easy participation points. Tests are not bad but you definitely have to study for them, so don't underestimate them or you will end up without an A.

Dr. Mahajan might be my favorite prof I've had in college. She is one of the nicest people I've ever met and cares so much about her students. Class wasn't easy but she was more than willing to help out students who were willing to make an effort. I wish she taught every management class.

She's honestly not bad, but she makes lecture long and boring. She makes you do busy work and the exams are a bit challenging. You have to read because she does not cover everything is class. I heard the other professor is easier but Vanita makes you work for your grade. She has a strong character but only because she really wants students to learn
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ms. Mahajan is one of the best teachers Ive had in college. She truly cares about her students and can sense when you arent understanding something and knows to go back over it again. She will modify her tests/quizzes if she thinks you wont understand the material and always wants you to do well. The material is challenging but she is amazing.

Easily best class I've taken, ever. Prof Mahajan is interesting and genuinely really cares about her students. I had her 8am section and was still excited to go. With that being said, this class isn't easy and requires you to pay attention, but as long as you keep up with the reading you'll be fine.

very long and boring lectures. group work that sucks. but she's a very kind lady, and her tests aren't too bad if you review your notes and pay attention in class. essay questions on tests which usually aren't bad (make sure to pay attention when she talks about 1 thing for a long time bc thats an essay question). HORRIBLE EXPLAINER!

Professor Mahajan is a wonderful lady! She really cares that you learn the material for this class and that is why I think this is a difficult course. The group project was very confusing and vague, but she takes advise from her students to change things for the next semester. Participation in class will actually help you learn the material!

I absolutely loved her class. She made me spark an interest in international business that I didn't even know I had. She is passionate about making sure that students learn and will stop and ask often if we understand what is going on. She knows it is a lot so she does her best to let us soak it in. TAKE HER!! Best prof at Mays!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Would take again

reviews.comment: Took her because of recommendations from here but regret it. Prof is nice but the class is terrible. Material and lectures are very boring. She takes attendance. You must read and memorize small details in the textbook/slides. Tests are extremely difficult: multiple choice/fill in the blank/short essay. The hardest class I've taken at A&M.

Arguably my  favorite professor at A&M. Class is tough, but she makes it so interesting, and truly cares about her students. Stay on top of the readings (which follow the powerpoint) and you'll be fine. I felt motivated to work for this class because of Dr. Mahajan. She rocks!

Take her class! She is extremely knowledgable and really makes sure that students are understanding the material and really learning it.  If you ever have difficulties or concerns about an assignment, discuss it with her; she is very open to feedback and is willing to work with you to make sure you are prepared to succeed.
Loved taking her class - it is not the easiest material, but she makes it so that each student can understand and she truly cares about her students. Would definitely recommend her to anyone!!
Class is very tough but I have never met a professor who cares more about her students than Professor Mahajan does.
